observe.result-sheet-or-poster.ig: Mpempe akwụkwọ nsonaazụ ma ọ bụ pọsta

observe.ec8a-sheet-or-ec60e-poster.en: The EC8A sheet, or the EC60E poster pasted up at the unit
observe.ec8a-sheet-or-ec60e-poster.ha: Takardar EC8A, ko fostar EC60E da aka liƙa a rukunin zaɓe
observe.ec8a-sheet-or-ec60e-poster.ig: Mpempe akwụkwọ EC8A, ma ọ bụ pọsta EC60E a madoro n'ngalaba ntuli aka
observe.ec8a-sheet-or-ec60e-poster.yo: Ìwé EC8A, tàbí pósítà EC60E tí wọ́n lẹ̀ mọ́ ògiri ní ẹ̀ka ìdìbò

observe.parts-hint.en: Poster too big for one clear photo, or on several sheets? Add the rest in order, from the top.
observe.parts-hint.ha: Fostar ta fi girma ga hoto ɗaya mai kyau, ko tana kan takardu da yawa? Ƙara sauran a jere, daga sama.
observe.parts-hint.ig: Pọsta ahụ ọ buru oke ibu maka otu foto doro anya, ma ọ bụ ọ dị n'ọtụtụ mpempe akwụkwọ? Tinye ndị fọdụrụ n'usoro, site n'elu.
observe.parts-hint.yo: Ṣé pósítà náà tóbi jù fún fọ́tò kan tó ṣe kedere, tàbí ó wà lórí ìwé púpọ̀? Fi àwọn yòókù kún un ní tẹ̀lé-n-tẹ̀lé, láti òkè.

observe.add-next-part.yo: Fi apá tó kàn kún un

observe.parts-joined.ig: E jikọtara foto {n} ka ha bụrụ otu
observe.parts-joined.yo: A ti so fọ́tò {n} pọ̀ di ọ̀kan

observe.parts-join-failed.en: Could not join the photos. Take them again.
observe.parts-join-failed.ha: Ba a iya haɗa hotunan ba. Sake ɗaukar su.
observe.parts-join-failed.ig: Enweghị ike ijikọ foto ndị ahụ. See ha ọzọ.
observe.parts-join-failed.yo: A kò lè so àwọn fọ́tò náà pọ̀. Tún wọn yà.
